The '''''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser''', also called the '''''Interdictor''-class cruiser''', the '''''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer''', or simply the '''Imperial Interdictor''', was an [[Interdictor]] vessel that served as the successor to the [[Immobilizer 418 cruiser]]. Developed and used by the [[Galactic Empire]], the craft was capable of emitting an [[interdiction field]] to pull passing ships out of [[hyperspace]] or prevent them from going to lightspeed. Despite being a relatively rare sight in the [[Imperial Navy]], it was considered a dangerous design by rebel groups that relied on hit-and-run tactics. It was used against the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|rebellion]] in [[4 BBY]], and several featured as part of the [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|7th Fleet]].

==Description==
[[File:Interdictor-FFG.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Interdictor'' prevents a CR90 corvette from entering hyperspace.]]
The ''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser,<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> also known as the ''Interdictor''-class cruiser<ref name="Battles" /> or ''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer,<ref name="Timelines" /> was a class of [[heavy cruiser]]<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> and [[Star Destroyer]].<ref name="Timelines" /> The ship was the successor model to the [[Immobilizer 418 cruiser]].<ref name="BMF 87" /> The [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer|''Interdictor''-class]] would ultimately arise, however.<ref name="Heir to the Jedi">''[[Heir to the Jedi]]''</ref>

It possessed four spherical [[gravity well projector]]s, which contained equipment to pull a number of ships out of [[hyperspace]]. It was 1,129 [[meter]]s in length and could achieve a speed of 975 [[Kilometer per hour|kilometers per hour]]. It was equipped with a class 2 [[hyperdrive]]<ref name="Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles" /> as well as a [[deflector shield generator]].<ref name="Stealth Strike" /> The ''Interdictor''-class was armed with twenty [[quad laser cannon]]s,<ref name="Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles" /> and outfitted with [[escape pod]]s.<ref name="Stealth Strike" /> It could maintain a complement of twenty-four [[TIE series|TIE fighter series]] [[starfighter]]s<ref name="Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles" /> deployed from one ventral [[hangar]] bay opening.<ref name="Stealth Strike" /> ''Interdictor''-class heavy cruisers were crewed by 2,800 personnel,<ref name="Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles" /> including [[Imperial officer]]s, [[Imperial weapons technician]]s, and [[stormtrooper]]s.<ref name="Stealth Strike" />

==Role==
The ''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser served in the capacity of an [[interdictor]] vessel and [[command ship]].<ref name="Stealth Strike" /> In this role, it was deployed to blockade worlds, investigate suspicious [[hyperspace route]]s, and prevent the escape of enemy ships. ''Interdictor''-class vessels typically formed part of small [[battle group]]s, supporting heavier lines of [[capital ship]]s in conjunction with [[frigate]]s and starfighters.<ref name="Starships and Speeders" />

==History==
The [[Interdictor (Interdictor-class)|''Interdictor'']], a prototype ''Interdictor''-class [[heavy cruiser]], was tested in the [[Del Zennis system]]<ref name="USWNE">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> in [[4 BBY]],<ref name="Stealth Strike date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Stealth Strike]]" to [[4 BBY]].</ref> under the command of [[Admiral]] [[Brom Titus]]. After pulling the rebel [[Starship|ship]] [[Liberator (CR90 corvette)|''Liberator'']] out of hyperspace, the crew was [[Prison|imprisoned]]. However, they [[Rescue on the Imperial Interdictor|escaped]] and sabotaged the ship, destroying it in the process of their escape.<ref name="Stealth Strike" /> Sometime before its destruction, the ''Interdictor'' created an interdiction field around a planet with two other ''Interdictor''-class heavy cruisers that prevented a [[CR90 corvette]] from entering hyperspace.<ref name="Armada">{{Armada|set=Interdictor Expansion Pack|cardname=''Interdictor''}}</ref>

In [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Zero Hour]]" to [[2 BBY]].</ref> two were used by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Empire)|Seventh Fleet]] during its [[Battle of Atollon|assault]] on [[Atollon]]. However, the [[Kassius Konstantine's Interdictor|cruiser]] under the command of Admiral [[Kassius Konstantine]] was drawn out of position by an an approaching rebel [[Phoenix Nest|''Quasar Fire''-class cruiser-carrier]], as the admiral sought personal glory and was sick of Thrawn's games. The [[carrier]] deliberately [[Death|collided]] with the [[Interdictor]], destroying both ships, to allow [[Ezra Bridger]]'s [[Nightbrother (Gauntlet fighter)|''Gauntlet'']] to escape and seek reinforcements. The [[Constrainer|other cruiser]] was later destroyed by a [[Mandalorian]] strike team from [[Clan Wren]], brought by Bridger.<ref name="Zero Hour" />

[[File:Rebellion_in_the_Rim_cover_art.png|thumb|right|220px|An ''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser in battle against an MC75 Star Cruiser]]
During the [[Galactic Civil War]], an ''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser fought alongside other Imperial forces against an [[MC75 Star Cruiser]], at least two [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]s, and other [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] forces.<ref name="Rebellion in the Rim">{{Armada|set=Rebellion in the Rim}}</ref> The ''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser later gave way to the [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer|''Interdictor''-class Star Destroyer]] line.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref>

At the [[5 ABY|time]] of the [[Battle of Jakku]], one of the last ''Interdictor''-class heavy cruisers, the ''[[Spectral]]'', guarded the [[Fondor Shipyards|shipyards]] of [[Fondor]], before the [[Battle of Fondor Shipyards|fall]] of the [[planet]] to the [[New Republic]]. The ship left for [[Jakku]], but was brought down by the efforts of [[Bak Rychuk]] and his droid [[Zeetoo-Zeetoo]], and crashed on the surface.<ref name="The Ghost Ship">{{StoryCite|story=The Ghost Ship|book=Star Wars Adventures: Destroyer Down}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser first appeared in "[[Stealth Strike]]," an episode of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.<ref name="Stealth Strike" /> The ship originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity as the [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]].<ref name="TIS">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The [[2018]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' states that the ''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser had a complement of 24 TIE fighters,<ref name="Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles" /> while the [[2019]] reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' establishes that ''Interdictor''-class heavy cruisers possess a complement of 20 TIE fighters,<ref name="USWNE" /> As the [[2020]] sourcebook ''[[Starships and Speeders]]'' establishes that they had a complement of 24 TIE series fighters of mixed designation, and ''Starships and Speeders'' is the most recently published source,<ref name="Starships and Speeders" /> this article assumes ''Starships and Speeders'' is correct.
